pick.headline: Checkpoint Charlie dismantled
pick.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of June 25, 1990, carried East Berlin ADN: Checkpoint Charlie dismantled before the four Allied, FRG and GDR foreign ministers, with Dumas calling it 'a ceremony for freedom'.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: East Europe, No. 122, 25 June 1990
